description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git attribute functionality, including checking attributes, handling paths, recursive macros, and symlinks within a Git repository context.

methods.name: attr_check_basic
methods.description: Checks basic attribute with an expected value for a given path.

methods.name: attr_check
methods.description: Performs attribute check and ensures error output is empty.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode_basic
methods.description: Checks the object mode attribute for a path.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode
methods.description: Checks object mode with additional validation.

methods.name: attr_check_quote
methods.description: Checks attribute with quoted path and expected value.

methods.name: attr_check_source
methods.description: Checks attributes with a specific source and multiple verification methods.
